# unraid_ups_configuration (Data Source)

UPS (apcupsd) configuration. Values are returned as stored, typically lower-case.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_ups_configuration" "this" {}

output "ups_shutdown_battery_level" {
  value = data.unraid_ups_configuration.this.battery_level
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `battery_level` (Number) Battery percentage that triggers shutdown.
- `custom_ups_cable` (String) Custom cable string (when `ups_cable` is `custom`).
- `device` (String) Device path or network address.
- `kill_ups` (String) `yes` or `no`: power off the UPS after shutdown.
- `minutes` (Number) Remaining runtime (minutes) that triggers shutdown.
- `model_name` (String) Overridden UPS model name.
- `net_server` (String) `on` or `off`: allow network clients.
- `nis_ip` (String) Network information server listen address.
- `override_ups_capacity` (Number) Overridden UPS capacity.
- `service` (String) `enable` or `disable`.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds on battery before shutdown; 0 disables.
- `ups_cable` (String) Cable type, e.g. `usb`, `smart`, `ether`, `custom`.
- `ups_name` (String) UPS name for network monitoring.
- `ups_type` (String) Communication type, e.g. `usb`, `net`, `snmp`.
